title: Guest Towel Holder Stand, Allied Brass, Polished Brass
body_html:
Keep hand towels right where guests need them—at the sink—without flimsy stands or mismatched finishes — available in Polished Brass, which brings warm, golden elegance that complements traditional faucets and classic bathroom fixtures. Backed by a Limited Lifetime Warranty, this Carolina Collection guest towel stand brings classic, traditional style to your bathroom vanity.

  • Polished Brass brings warm, timeless elegance
  • Coordinates with other Carolina pieces for a timeless, unified look
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Elevates classic bath accessories with traditional, timeless design details
  • Solid brass construction outlasts die-cast zinc alternatives for everyday bathroom use

Specs

  • Product type: Guest towel holder stand (freestanding towel holder)
  • Mounting/placement: Countertop (freestanding)
  • Material: Brass (solid brass materials)
  • Dimensions (L x H x W): 16.3 in x 14 in x 5.5 in
  • Available size: 11 Inch
  • Weight capacity: 20 lb
  • Assembly required: No
  • Included items: Freestanding towel holder
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

Complete your bathroom with matching pieces from the Carolina collection.
meta_description: Traditional guest towel holder stand for bathroom countertops. 11-inch Carolina Collection design in solid brass with heavy base and felt pad. Allied Brass.
